title: Duterte's defense witness admits Cale88 has 'red flags'
summary: A defense witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte admitted that there were "red flags" in the operations of Cale88 but said these do not necessarily mean wrongdoing.

blocks.text: A witness for the defense in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte admitted that there were "red flags" in the operations of Cale88, but maintained that these do not necessarily mean wrongdoing.

Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros asked AML Consulting PH head Rainer Dela Fuente whether he knew if Cale88—the food company being linked to Duterte's spouse Manases Carpio—had a legitimate explanation for its suspicious transactions reports to the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC).
Dela Fuente replied in the negative.
“Masasabi niyo po bang unusual itong total of 757 CTRs and STRs na may halagang P1,245,736,297.8?” Hontiveros asked.
(Would you say that having 757 covered transaction reports [CTRs] and suspicious transaction reports [STRs] worth P1,245,736,297.8 is unusual?)
Dela Fuente said that only the AMLC could determine if this was suspicious, but maintained that suspicion is not a direct indication of unlawful activity.
He said that there are with many more CTRs and STRs than what Cale88 had.
Hontiveros asked about the AMLC's flagging Cale88’s two employees, as well as its transactions with China.
"Lastly po, Attorney De La Fuente, hindi po ba yan posibleng mga [are these not possible] red flags?" Hontiveros asked.
"Yes, these are red flags po that merit…scrutiny, review, opo, but again red flags po are not direct evidence of wrongdoing, " Dela Fuente replied.

During Hontiveros’ questioning, Dela Fuente also said that he previously worked with gambling businesses and Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators. He was also a previous consultant for the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR). — BM, GMA News
